examples.english: Leaders of the Andalusian independence movement who were consulted maintain that the manifesto distills the patrimonialist feeling that Rojas-Marcos has always held toward the PA [Andalusian Party], a faction which he founded during the last years of the Franco regime as Political Compromise, later changed to Andalusian Socialist Alliance and in 1976 to Socialist Party of Andalusia.
examples.ref: 2015 July 17, Lourdes Lucio, “Los líderes históricos andalucistas defienden la disolución del partido”, in El País:
examples.text: Dirigentes andalucistas consultados aseguran que el manifiesto destila el sentido patrimonialista que Rojas-Marcos siempre ha tenido del PA, una formación que él fundó en el tardofranquismo como Compromiso Político, luego mutó en Alianza Socialista Andaluza y en el 1976 en Partido Socialista de Andalucía.
examples.translation: Leaders of the Andalusian independence movement who were consulted maintain that the manifesto distills the patrimonialist feeling that Rojas-Marcos has always held toward the PA [Andalusian Party], a faction which he founded during the last years of the Franco regime as Political Compromise, later changed to Andalusian Socialist Alliance and in 1976 to Socialist Party of Andalusia.

glosses: the final years of Francoism, from 1969 to 1975
